description: Daily Radix mainnet activity, one row per UTC day since Babylon (28 September 2023): transactions, active accounts, new accounts, components and resources created, NFTs minted, and fees, $XRD burned and royalties in $XRD. Summed from the Gateway transaction stream; counts cover user transactions only. Narrow with from/to. The same rows chart at /charts and download at /api/charts/activity?format=csv.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 30 days before the last stored day)

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the last stored day)

name: get_network_activity
title: Radix network activity
